assumptions: The zero-cost trade check is the only check that can reject a legitimate match with disjoint matched amounts in the reported scenario.
Matched base and quote amounts are observable integer quantities at the check checkpoint.

unresolved.description: The report does not state the exact revert condition (omitted code lines 503-504 and 544-545), so the precise predicate under which the legitimate disjoint-bit match is rejected cannot be bound beyond the observable rejection occurrence.
Whether the disjoint-bit matched amounts are attacker-chosen or arise naturally is not stated; the plan encodes only the report-supported disjoint-bit scenario.

limitations: The impact is potential; the plan encodes the report-supported conditional scenario in which a legitimate disjoint-bit match is rejected, not an inevitable failure.
Caller identity and authorization for triggering the match are unspecified and not encoded.
The bitwise-AND-zero encoding represents the report's 'no overlapping 1-bits' relation; the illustrative literals 256 and 1..255 are examples, not bounds.
Only the selected impact traders_encounter_unexplained_failures is formalized; other impacts are handled separately.
